seed_notes.ABANTU_BATHO_CONGRESS: entrant from nothing: even share of every pool. Sized at the EXPECTED result for the 23 arrivals that contested about as much of a city (86% of wards): mean 0.32%, median 0.08%, band 0.04%-1.61%. THE EVEN SPREAD IS A PLACEHOLDER: declare which pools it pulls from and what support you expect. | group rescaled x0.23: 26 entrants summing to 7.11% against an arrival-total record of 1.62%

seed_notes.ASA: SPLIT from DA (Mashaba, the DA's own mayor of Johannesburg, who resigned the party in October 2019): takes 3.5% of a vector that is 35% DA's pool rates and 65% the city's own composition — measured, median over 22 splinter-metro cases. Band 0.5%-27.2% from the away splinter record. Every party in those pools gives up the same proportion; none is named.
